messages.subject: Project Willow - completed
messages.plaintextBody:
Catherine, Tom,

I'm pleased to confirm that the acquisition of Westmere Coatings completed this afternoon. The consideration has been paid, the retention is in the joint account, and Tom is now a director of the company. We'll attend to the Companies House filings and the stamping of the transfers, and will circulate a completion bible in due course. Congratulations to the whole team.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
